item.title: BTS announce 2026–2027 world tour: Singapore, Manila, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok & more confirmed
item.description: BTS are back on the road — and they’re gearing up for their biggest world tour yet. The K-pop icons have just revealed the cities and dates for their 2026–2027 world tour, which will include 79 shows across 34 cities, with stops in Singapore, Manila, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, and more. item.description: Former NewJeans member Danielle Marsh has finally broken the silence on her front after a messy departure from ADOR. item.title: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and President Lee Jae Myung turn Japan–South Korea summit into a K-pop drum jam
item.description: On 13 January, Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and South Korea’s President Lee Jae Myung wrapped up the first day of their bilateral summit in Nara with an unexpected cultural moment: a joint drumming session soundtracked by K-pop. The performance took place at the end of day one of the two-day talks, held in Nara — the capital of Takaichi’s home prefecture.
